title: Inventory & Sales Tracker (Frontend): II-gated app with onboarding, product & sales flows, dashboard, notifications placeholder, and cohesive theme

requirements.summary: Gate all app features behind Internet Identity login with sign-in/sign-out UX and authenticated-only data views.
acceptanceCriteria: User can sign in and sign out using Internet Identity.
When signed out, the user cannot view or mutate products/sales data.
All backend calls that read/write app data require an authenticated principal (or otherwise only operate on caller-owned data).

file_operations.description: Create the root app component that uses the immutable useInternetIdentity hook to gate the application: show a signed-out screen with a login CTA, and show the authenticated app shell only when identity is present. Use shadcn-ui layout primitives (e.g., Card/Button) to present the signed-out state; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a reusable Login/Logout button that uses the immutable useInternetIdentity hook and clears React Query cache on logout (per the authorization component guidance). Use shadcn-ui Button and optionally a loading state; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an AuthGate wrapper component that centralizes: (1) signed-out blocking UI, (2) handling login status/error display, and (3) rendering children only when authenticated. Use shadcn-ui Alert/Card for error messaging; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an authenticated app shell (header + navigation + content slot) that is only rendered inside AuthGate. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., NavigationMenu/Sheet for mobile nav) for responsive navigation; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add first-time onboarding/profile setup after login and allow later profile edits (display name + default low-stock threshold).
acceptanceCriteria: First-time logged-in users are prompted to complete onboarding fields before accessing the main app.
Profile data persists across reloads and re-logins for the same Internet Identity principal.
Users can later update onboarding/profile fields from within the app.

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for current user profile: getCallerUserProfile + saveCallerUserProfile via the immutable useActor hook, following the authorization component guidance to avoid profile-setup UI flash (custom isLoading/isFetched handling). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement an onboarding dialog shown only when authenticated and getCallerUserProfile returns null; collect display name and default low-stock threshold with validation and English error messages. Use shadcn-ui Dialog/Form controls; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a profile settings view that allows updating display name and default low-stock threshold after onboarding is complete. Use shadcn-ui Card/Input/Button and show success/error feedback; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire onboarding gating into the authenticated flow: after login, fetch current profile and block access to the main app content until onboarding is completed; add navigation access to Profile settings once onboarded. Use the authorization component guidance for gating behavior; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement product CRUD UI with validation and list management for sales/profit and low-stock logic.
acceptanceCriteria: User can add a product and it appears in the product list after creation.
User can edit an existing product and changes persist.
User can delete a product and it is removed from the list and no longer available for new sales entries.
Validation prevents invalid numeric values (e.g., negative quantities/prices) and shows user-facing error messages in English.

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for product list and product mutations (create/update/delete) via the immutable useActor hook; ensure queries are enabled only when authenticated and actor is available, and invalidate/refetch lists after mutations. Use patterns consistent with the authorization component guidance; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the Products management view: list products, open add/edit form, and allow delete with confirmation. Use shadcn-ui Table, Dialog, AlertDialog, and Form inputs; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement a product create/edit dialog with fields: name, cost price, sale price, current stock quantity, and optional low-stock threshold override. Add client-side validation (non-negative numbers, required name) with English error text. Use shadcn-ui Dialog, Input, and form patterns; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a reusable product list/table component with edit/delete actions and consistent formatting for prices/quantities. Use shadcn-ui Table/Badge components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the Products view into the authenticated navigation so it is reachable only after login and onboarding completion (no orphan views). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement sales recording form with profit calculation display and inventory stock constraints, plus sales history list.
acceptanceCriteria: User can record a sale and it persists; the sale appears in a sales list/history view.
Profit is automatically calculated and stored/displayed (profit = (unitSalePrice - unitCostPrice) * quantity).
Recording a sale decrements the product stock by the sold quantity and prevents selling more than available stock (unless explicitly allowed; if not allowed, show an error).
User-facing numbers are displayed consistently (e.g., currency formatting if applicable) and all user-facing text is in English.

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for sales history queries and recording a sale via the immutable useActor hook; after recording a sale, invalidate both sales and products queries so stock updates in UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a Sales view containing: (1) a sales recording form and (2) a sales history list. Use shadcn-ui Card/Table components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement sale recording form fields: date/time, product, quantity, optional unit sale price override, and optional notes. Source unit cost price from selected product. Show computed profit preview and validate: quantity > 0, cannot exceed available stock (show English error). Use shadcn-ui Select/Popover/Calendar (or DateTime input) and form inputs; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Render sales history with timestamp, product (by name lookup), quantity, sale price, cost price, and profit. Use consistent number formatting and English labels. Use shadcn-ui Table; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add shared formatting helpers for currency/number and date/time display used across products, sales, and dashboard to ensure consistent user-facing numbers and English formatting defaults (e.g., en-US).
Wire the Sales view into authenticated navigation and ensure it is only accessible after login and onboarding completion. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Create a dashboard with selectable day summary metrics and low-stock alerts derived from product thresholds (override or user default).
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard loads after login and shows a clear daily summary for ‘today’ by default.
User can change the day (at least to previous days) and the summary updates accordingly.
Low-stock alert section lists products whose stock is at or below their threshold.
Dashboard data reflects recorded products and sales accurately after creating/editing records.

file_operations.description: Create the Dashboard view as the default authenticated screen: show daily summary metrics for the selected day and a low-stock alerts section. Use shadcn-ui Card, Tabs/Segmented controls, and date picker controls; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a hook that fetches sales for a selected day (via getSalesByDateRange) and low-stock alerts (via getLowStockAlerts) using the immutable useActor hook; compute summary metrics in the frontend (sales count, revenue, cost, profit) and return UI-ready data. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add reusable metric cards (sales count, revenue, cost, profit) with consistent number formatting and English labels. Use shadcn-ui Card components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Render low-stock products list with threshold context (product override vs user default) and current stock. Use shadcn-ui Table/Badge/Alert components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Set Dashboard as the default authenticated route/view and wire it into navigation. Ensure it remains gated by login and onboarding completion. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a Notifications/Integrations settings area with WhatsApp clearly marked as not enabled in v1 (placeholder-only).
acceptanceCriteria: App includes a Notifications/Integrations section that mentions WhatsApp is optional and not active in v1.
No real WhatsApp messages are sent; the UI must not require external credentials to function.
Any future-facing controls are disabled or clearly labeled as placeholders.

file_operations.description: Create a Notifications/Integrations view that clearly states WhatsApp notifications are not enabled in v1. Add placeholder controls that are disabled and labeled as coming soon, without requesting credentials. Use shadcn-ui Card, Switch, and Alert components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the Notifications/Integrations view into authenticated navigation (behind login and onboarding completion). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive, responsive visual theme across the app with a non-blue/non-purple primary palette.
acceptanceCriteria: All main screens share consistent typography, spacing, and component styling.
Primary color palette does not use blue/purple as the main brand colors.
Layout is responsive and usable on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Add global styles and Tailwind CSS variables for a cohesive theme (typography, spacing defaults, component surface colors). Set a distinctive primary color that is not blue/purple (e.g., emerald/green or amber) by adjusting CSS variables consumed by shadcn-ui (e.g., --primary / --primary-foreground). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the authenticated layout is responsive (mobile navigation via collapsible drawer/sheet, consistent paddings, readable typography) and applies the theme consistently across Dashboard, Products, Sales, Notifications, and Profile. Use shadcn-ui responsive primitives; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust dashboard spacing, headings, and component composition to match the global theme and improve mobile usability (stacked cards, readable tables). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Align Products UI with the global theme (consistent cards, table density, button variants, form spacing) and ensure mobile usability. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Align Sales UI with the global theme (form layout, table responsiveness, consistent labels) and ensure mobile usability. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Align Profile Settings UI with the global theme and ensure consistent typography/spacing across settings screens. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align Notifications/Integrations placeholder UI with the global theme, including disabled control styling and clear informational messaging. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
